name: Lionel FasTrack
description: Lionel FasTrack is the modern O-gauge sectional track system introduced in 2005, with an integrated molded roadbed. Curves are named by their nominal diameter in inches (e.g. 'O36' = 36-inch diameter). All centerline radii are half the nominal diameter. Standard curve sections sweep 30 degrees (O36) or 22.5 degrees (O48 and larger), so 12 sections of O36 or 16 sections of larger curves complete a full circle. The system includes straights from 1.375 in (fitter) to 40 in, manual and remote turnouts in O36 / O48 / O60 / O72 frog sizes, 45 and 90 degree crossings, terminal sections, bumpers, a rerailer, and a transition piece to legacy O / O27 tubular track.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/lionel-fastrack.md for per-system caveats.
